entries.question: KGMU OPD appointment kitne baje Tak mil sakta hai
entries.answer:
KGMU OPD mein parchi (ticket) counter subah 9:00 baje khulta hai aur dopahar 1:00 baje sharp band ho jata hai. Isliye, OPD slip lene ya banwane ki antim samay seema 1:00 baje hai.

Behtar hoga ki aap samay se pehle pahunchein ya online booking (ORS) ka upyog karein, kyunki bheed adhik ho sakti hai.

**OPD Booking ke tareeke:**
*   **Online:** [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par jaakar appointment book karein.
*   **SMS:** `APPOINTMENT <NAME>` likhkar 8887019134 par bhejein.
*   **Walk-in:** Apna Aadhaar card aur mobile number lekar aayein, OTP ke zariye token lekar ₹50 ka shulk jama karke slip prapt karein.

**Dhyan dein:** OPD ka samay Somwar se Shukrawar subah 9:00 se 1:00 baje tak aur Shaniwar ko subah 9:00 se 12:00 baje tak hota hai. Sunday ko OPD band rehti hai.

entries.question: Can I direct apply for pharmacist
entries.answer:

3.  **Follow the Prescribed Method:** Applications are typically accepted only through an official online portal or as specified in the recruitment advertisement (e.g., via speed post or a designated digital link). 
4.  **Avoid Unofficial Sources:** Please be cautious of any third-party websites or individuals claiming they can facilitate a "direct" or "backdoor" entry. All hiring at KGMU is merit-based and follows the official government recruitment guidelines.

If you are currently looking for opportunities, please keep checking the [official KGMU website](https://www.kgmu.org) periodically for any new notifications.

* **सोमवार से शुक्रवार:** सुबह 9:00 बजे से दोपहर 1:00 बजे तक।
* **शनिवार:** सुबह 9:00 बजे से दोपहर 12:00 बजे तक।

**3. शुल्क (Fee):**
* सभी बुकिंग माध्यमों (ऑनलाइन या वॉक-इन) के लिए OPD पर्ची का शुल्क **₹50** है।

**4. वॉक-इन (Walk-in) नियम:**
* यदि आपने पहले से अपॉइंटमेंट नहीं लिया है, तो आप अस्पताल आकर भी पंजीकरण करा सकते हैं। इसके लिए अपना **आधार कार्ड** और **सक्रिय मोबाइल नंबर** साथ रखें। OTP के माध्यम से आपका पंजीकरण होगा, जिसके बाद आप टोकन लेकर ₹50 जमा कर पर्ची प्राप्त कर सकते हैं।

**5. महत्वपूर्ण निर्देश:**
* **रेफरल (Referral):** यदि आप लखनऊ के बाहर से आ रहे हैं, तो संबंधित विभाग के लिए वैध रेफरल पत्र साथ लाना अनिवार्य है।
* **समय का पालन:** भीड़ से बचने के लिए पहले से अपॉइंटमेंट बुक करना बेहतर होता है।
* **सुरक्षा:** कृपया इस चैट में अपना आधार नंबर, फोन नंबर या कोई भी व्यक्तिगत स्वास्थ्य रिकॉर्ड साझा न करें।

यदि आपको किसी विशेष विभाग या डॉक्टर के बारे में अधिक जानकारी चाहिए, तो आप पूछ सकते हैं। यदि आपको कोई स्वास्थ्य समस्या है, तो कृपया KGMU की OPD में जाकर डॉक्टर से व्यक्तिगत रूप से परामर्श लें।

entries.answer:
Haan, KGMU mein transplant (pratyaropan) ki prakriya mein shulk (fees) lagta hai. KGMU ek sarkari shikshan aur chikitsa sansthan hai, jahan ilaaj ka kharch private hospitals ki tulna mein kafi kam hota hai, lekin yeh nishulk (free) nahi hai.

Transplant ka kul kharch kai baaton par nirbhar karta hai:
1. **Transplant ka prakar:** Jaise Kidney, Liver, ya anya angon ka transplant.
2. **Janch aur dawaiyan:** Surgery se pehle ki janch, surgery ke dauran ka kharch, aur surgery ke baad ki dawaiyan.
3. **Hospital mein bharti hone ka samay.**

**Kharch ke bare mein jaankari ke liye:**
* **Rate List:** Aap KGMU ki official website par [Rate List](https://www.kgmu.org/rate_list2223.htm) dekh sakte hain. Ismein vibhinn surgeries aur services ka anumanit shulk diya gaya hai.
* **Vibhag se sampark:** Transplant ke liye aapko us sambandhit vibhag (jaise Urology ya Gastroenterology) mein jana hoga. Wahan ke **Patient Welfare Office** ya billing counter se aapko surgery ke liye lagne wale sahi kharch ka estimate (prakalpan) mil sakta hai.
* **Sahayata:** Agar aap kisi aarthik roop se kamzor varg (BPL) se hain, toh sarkari yojanaon (jaise Ayushman Bharat) ke tahat kuch suvidhayen mil sakti hain. Iske bare mein aap KGMU ke **Patient Welfare Office** mein jakar zaroor poochein.

**Salah:** Aap seedhe us department mein jayein jahan transplant hota hai, wahan ke doctors aur administrative staff aapko surgery ke kul kharch aur process ke bare mein sahi jankari de payenge.

entries.question: Hair fall issues kis vibhag mein dikhaye
entries.answer:
Hair fall (baal jhadne) ki samasya ke liye aapko **Dermatology, Venereology & Leprosy** vibhag mein dikhana chahiye.

KGMU mein is vibhag ki OPD mein dikhane ke liye aap ye steps follow kar sakte hain:

1.  **Online Registration (Anivarya):** Sabse pehle [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par jakar apna appointment book karein.
2.  **OPD Timing:** OPD subah 9:00 baje se shuru hoti hai. Parchi/ticket counter 1:00 baje dopahar ko band ho jata hai, isliye samay se pahunchna zaroori hai.
3.  **OPD Fee:** OPD slip ka shulk ₹50 hai.
4.  **Documents:** Apne saath apna **Aadhaar card** aur **active mobile number** zaroor rakhein (OTP verification ke liye).
5.  **Location:** Dermatology vibhag ke baare mein adhik jankari ke liye aap [KGMU ki official website](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=12&dept_type=2) dekh sakte hain.

**Mahatvapurn Suchna:**
*   Main aapko koi medical advice ya ilaj nahi de sakta. Kripya kisi qualified doctor se hi paramarsh lein. 
*   Apni safety ke liye chat mein koi bhi personal medical record, Aadhaar number ya phone number share na karein.

entries.question: Who will do the surgery
entries.answer:
The surgical procedure for a Lipomyelomeningocele (Lipo-MMC) in a child involves specialized surgeons from the **Department of Neurosurgery** and/or the **Department of Pediatric Surgery**.

At KGMU, these surgeries are typically performed by senior faculty members who specialize in pediatric neuro-spinal conditions. Because this is a complex procedure, the specific surgical team is decided after the patient is evaluated by the consultants in the OPD.

**How to identify the surgical team for your child:**

1.  **Visit the OPD:** You must first consult with a doctor in the **Department of Neurosurgery** or **Department of Pediatric Surgery**. They will review the MRI and clinical findings to determine if the case is best handled by a Neurosurgeon, a Pediatric Surgeon, or a combined team.
2.  **Faculty Information:** You can view the profiles and specializations of the senior faculty members for these departments here:
    *   [Department of Neurosurgery](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=19&dept_type=2)
    *   [Department of Pediatric Surgery](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=7&dept_type=2)
3.  **Procedure:** Once the evaluation is complete, the department will provide you with a formal treatment plan, and the operating surgeon will be assigned based on the surgical complexity and the department's duty roster.

**Important:** Please do not rely on information from this chat to identify a specific surgeon for an operation. The final decision rests with the Head of the Department (HOD) or the attending consultant after they have physically examined the patient.
